puzzles.prompt: Which Mexican-born pitcher won both the NL Rookie of the Year and the Cy Young Award in 1981, sparking "Fernandomania"?
puzzles.explanation: Fernando Valenzuela from Etchohuaquila, Sonora, did it with the Dodgers in 1981 — the only player ever to win both in the same season.

puzzles.prompt: The champion of the Liga Mexicana del Pacífico goes on to play in which international tournament each February?
puzzles.explanation: The Serie del Caribe pits the winter-league champions of Mexico, the Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, Venezuela and others against each other.

puzzles.prompt: In American slang, if your food is "bussin’," it is…
puzzles.explanation: "Bussin’" means extremely good — usually about food.
